findings.finding: The README describes OpenTelemetry metrics as a feature the operator enables; no collection by the publisher is described. Quoted: “Integration with open telemetry meters to track tool-call volume, latency and failures in Streamable HTTP mode.”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`go.sum`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README carries a security note about untrusted clients and models; it does not name prompt injection or untrusted content returned by tools. Quoted: “Do not use the MCP server with untrusted MCP clients or LLMs.”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: go-sdk v1.8.0 (and mark3labs/mcp-go v0.58.0) in go.mod. Lower-bound version v1.8.0 of github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk was published on 2026-09-04, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
